restaurant_name: นิทราทันตแพทย์
text: I don't usually write reviews, whether good or bad, but this time it really took me a while. I would like to warn everyone that I do not recommend using their services. I live abroad and return to Thailand every two to three years. I decided to get my retainers made in August. Now that I am back abroad, it turns out that my retainer is chipped. I tried to contact them to refund the money or give me credit for next time (which I don't know if the clinic will still be open because when I went to get them made, I never saw a single patient waiting). They did not take any responsibility at all. They said I had to take it back to be repaired. Do I have to buy another 70,000 baht plane ticket to get a retainer repaired, which costs 2,000 baht per piece? If it takes that long, I understand, but I only had it made a month ago, so it shouldn't be damaged, right? They also said I dropped it. But even if I did, a retainer wouldn't break easily unless a car ran over it! (I have been a long-time customer of the clinic and know the assistant, but they still did not take any responsibility.) When I decided to do it, I was willing to pay 4,000 baht per pair (because I had retainers made three years ago and they were very durable and good). When I had them made at other places, they would cost a little over 2,000 baht per pair. If you have never been a patient, find another clinic. If you are an old patient, please move. There are many good and responsible clinics.

restaurant_name: นิทราทันตแพทย์
text: I used to go to Dr. Jum. She was very good. She examined meticulously and did the whole mouth. I'll see her again next year. There won't be any nagging problems. Now there's a new doctor who isn't as thorough. He does a decent job. But the old male doctor is still here. Plus, the assistant now has very bad manners with customers. I don't want to go see him anymore. I've been going since I was a child. What a shame.
